title: BBQ No-Fuss Haloumi Burgers
subtitle: with Shake 'n' Bake Fries
description: Whether you’re full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they’re packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they’re totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Bake fries: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Cut the unpeeled sweet potatoes into 1.5cm-thick fries. Put the fries, a quarter of the barbecue seasoning and 2 tsp olive oil in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Cover the bowl and shake until combined. Spread the fries over the lined tray and bake for 20-25 mins until tender.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, preheat the barbecue grill to medium-high (see Don't have a barbie?). Thinly slice the tomato. Cut the rolls in half. Slice the haloumi in half horizontally, drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil and season with pepper.

Toss salad: Combine 2 tsp olive oil and 1 tsp red wine vinegar in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the spinach and toss to coat. Combine a quarter of the barbecue seasoning and 2 tbs mayonnaise in a separate bowl.

Barbecue haloumi: Cook the haloumi on the barbecue grill for 2 mins each side or until grill marks are visible. Cook the rolls, cut-side down, on the barbecue grill for 1-2 mins until grill marks are visible. Remove the haloumi and rolls from the grill.

Serve up: Spread the roll bases with the mayo mixture and top with the spinach salad, tomato and haloumi. Sandwich with the roll tops. Divide the burgers among plates and serve with the fries and remaining salad. Enjoy!
Don't have a barbie?: No worries, you can use a chargrill pan or frypan to cook the haloumi and pop the bread rolls into the oven with the fries for about 5 mins or until lightly toasted.
